# EnvironmentalChemistry.com Editor's Blog

> > Kenneth Barbalace's blog exploring the intersection of environmental chemistry, energy policy, education, and scientific literacy through personal essays and policy analysis.

This blog covers energy efficiency, renewable energy policy, environmental sustainability, and science communication from an educator's perspective. Posts range from practical home weatherization guides to critiques of energy policy and debunking of health and environmental myths.

## Home Energy Efficiency & Weatherization

- [Home Weatherization Paying Off Big Time](https://blog.environmentalchemistry.com/2011/01/home-weatherization-pays-off-big-time.html): Article on home weatherization benefits and fuel oil consumption reduction
- [Using cool nights for a cooler home during the day at no cost](https://blog.environmentalchemistry.com/2010/07/using-cool-nights-for-cooler-home.html): Guide to passive cooling using natural ventilation for summer energy savings
- [Replacing windows & doors usually isn't best way to save energy](https://blog.environmentalchemistry.com/2010/03/replacing-windows-doors-usually-isnt.html): Analysis of window/door replacement ROI versus attic insulation for energy efficiency

## Energy Policy & Renewable Energy

- [Could Maine be Energy Self Sufficient in Ten Years?](https://blog.environmentalchemistry.com/2010/03/could-maine-be-energy-self-sufficient.html): Examines Maine's potential energy independence through renewable wind power
- [Renewable Energy, National Security and Social Justice](http://blog.environmentalchemistry.com/2007/09/renewable-energy-national-security-and.html): Explores renewable energy's role in national security and environmental justice
- [States Take Initiative to Reduce Greenhouse Gas Emissions](http://blog.environmentalchemistry.com/2007/08/states-take-initiative-to-reduce.html): Analysis of New Jersey and state climate policy for greenhouse gas emissions reduction
- [Congress proposes massive subsidies to convert coal into diesel fuel](http://blog.environmentalchemistry.com/2007/05/congress-proposes-massive-subsidies-to.html): Analysis of congressional coal-to-liquid fuel subsidies and emissions impact
- [Subsidies for coal to liquids compared to funding for other energy research](http://blog.environmentalchemistry.com/2007/06/subsidies-for-coal-to-liquids-compared.html): Comparison of coal-to-liquids subsidies versus renewable energy R&D spending
- [Coal-to-liquids vs. energy efficiency and renewable energies](http://blog.environmentalchemistry.com/2007/06/coal-to-liquids-vs-energy-efficiency.html): Policy analysis comparing coal-to-liquids against energy efficiency alternatives
- [Senate Considering Energy Assistance Fund](http://blog.environmentalchemistry.com/2009/05/energy-assistance-fund-act.html): Coverage of S.855 Energy Assistance Fund Act with Susan Collins and tax credits

## Corporate Sustainability & Green Technology

- [Google and Intel found computer energy efficiency initiative](http://blog.environmentalchemistry.com/2007/06/google-and-intel-found-computer-energy.html): Climate Savers Computing Initiative by Google and Intel for green computing
- [Rupert Murdoch and News Corp. going carbon neutral by 2010](http://blog.environmentalchemistry.com/2007/05/rupert-murdoch-and-news-corp-going.html): News Corp's corporate sustainability commitment to carbon neutrality by 2010

## Education & Labor

- [My teachers weren't lazy, incompetent, greedy, overpaid or thugs](https://blog.environmentalchemistry.com/2011/03/teachers-are-investment-in-our-future.html): Personal essay defending teachers and union rights during Wisconsin protests

## Science Communication & Myth Debunking

- [Glen Beck, H1N1 Vaccine, Ethyle Mercury & Dangerously Irresponsible Fear Mongering](http://blog.environmentalchemistry.com/2009/10/glen-beck-h1n1-vaccine-ethyle-mercury.html): Fact-check debunking vaccine thimerosal myths and mercury toxicity fears
- [Milk causes cancer: is this true, what is the real risk?](http://blog.environmentalchemistry.com/2007/05/milk-causes-cancer-is-this-true-what-is.html): Health myth debunking on milk and cancer risk with epidemiological evidence

## Environmental Health & Product Safety

- [Made in China with lead or other toxins](http://blog.environmentalchemistry.com/2007/08/made-in-china-with-lead-or-other-toxins.html): Product safety analysis of lead contamination and CPSC recalls for toys
- [Giving environmentalism a bad name; the death of good sense](http://blog.environmentalchemistry.com/2007/07/giving-environmentalism-bad-name-death.html): Critique of environmental activism opposing renewable energy in Southern California
